summary: Downies Collectables is a family-owned Melbourne coins, banknotes and collectables retailer and auction house (est. 1932) running NetSuite, Shopify and Celigo. The finance team includes CFO Jane Van Es, Finance Manager Tawanda Makaure (since April 2026, owns the close) and Finance Operations Manager Kaumudi Kuruppu.

claims.text: Downies Collectables is a family business founded in 1932 and based in Nunawading, Victoria.
Kaumudi Kuruppu is Finance Operations Manager at Downies, in the role since May 2021.
Kaumudi's profile describes supervising staff and assisting the costing process, reporting to the CFO.
claims.quote: supervising staff and assisting costing process

claims.text: Jane Van Es has been CFO of Downies since October 2022.
Finance Manager Tawanda Makaure says he owns the finance function end-to-end, including bank reconciliations and the month-end close.
claims.quote: I own the finance function end-to-end, overseeing payroll, accounts payable, bank reconciliations, and the month-end close

claims.text: Tawanda leads process improvements and integrations across NetSuite, Shopify, Celigo and Employment Hero.
claims.quote: I lead process improvements and system integrations across NetSuite, Shopify, Celigo, and Employment Hero

claims.text: Downies implemented NetSuite with Fusion5; COO Chris Sealey said the old system needed lots of transactions per task.
claims.quote: In the old system, lots of transactions were required to complete a task, leading to a lot of complexity.

claims.text: Downies is home to Biante Model Cars and distributes numismatic products for the Royal Australian Mint and The Perth Mint.
claims.quote: Downies Collectables is home to Biante Model Cars.

claims.text: Downies sells coins, mints, accessories, banknotes and subscriptions.
claims.quote: sells coins, mints, accessories, banknotes, and subscriptions

claims.text: Downies runs Australia's longest-running numismatic auction house.
claims.quote: Australia’s longest running numismatic auction house

hooks.text: NetSuite, Shopify and Celigo integration breaks create exception recs the finance team handles by hand.
Subscriptions and auctions add deferred revenue and settlement recs.

risks.text: Tawanda Makaure (the owner of the close) has no email on file; Kaumudi is the only contactable finance contact. Sent to Kaumudi, who may forward.
NetSuite stack may be seen as sufficient.

gaps: No finance job ad or funding news found.
No dated posts by the finance team found.
